guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.note: Batch 7 (19.3, 13.68, 21 Nov): his damage is in clashes (Bulwark: a Guard beat he wins hits back for winHitBase + his level, engagement.json). Ward: allies next to him get +1 defense (+2 under Stone) and he takes a third of each hit on them (half under Stone), rounded up, at most 4 (5); never below 1 health; off in a clash, when Stunned, at 1 health, or when switched off. Shield Bash (his Attack): 50 percent to Disorient on a hit (70 against an Off-Balance or Distracted foe), 2 more damage when it does; then 2 of his turns before it can again.

twinSpear.name: Spearman
twinSpear.note: Rabdul's style: a two-headed spear, fought up close. Same class as Gaha, a different kit. The heavier spear makes him slower than Gaha (speed 9, 3 steps): at Gaha's speed he reached the Sage too fast and the heroes almost never won.
twinSpear.note_kit: Batch 7 (19.4, 21 Nov): Spear Ward and Hold the Line (one stance at a time), Haft Sweep; Switch Ends (a Press beat he wins in a clash adds a rear-blade strike, engagement.json signatures.switchEnds; the second blow of his Double Hit +1); No Blind Side (attackers get +5 to hit him while he is in a clash with someone else, not +10).
twinSpear.note_mp: Enchant (roadmap 4.1) is magic, so Rabdul has his own MP: 9, Enchant costs 3.

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.note: Kofi (roadmap 6.38, M10b). FIRST VERSION of Suleiman's kit (Kofi_Ability_Sheet.pdf; all numbers are placeholders, his and ours). 'reading': each moment he reads the ground within 2 tiles of him; the strongest element there is the element of his Spirit Bolt, Haunt and Infuse (see reading() in BattleScene.js and 'readingRules' below). Spirit Bolt is his plain attack here (the sheet prices it at 2 MP; a caster needs one free attack). 27 Nov (13.72, Baiyee): Infuse is replaced by Call Spirit (src/spirits.js) and Spirit Swap; he keeps Haunt and the Reading (it colours his Spirit Bolt and Haunt, and picks the spirit on plain floor).

readingRules.note: Points for each thing within 'radius' tiles of him. highGround: he stands 2 or more levels up (our addition: the sheet has no map rule for Storm). A tie keeps the element he had; with nothing to read he falls back to water (his lantern's own green), at strength 0.

sage.name: Sage
sage.note_contest: Roadmap 9.5 (Suleiman 30 Oct 20:17 and 20:56): enemies can catch her in a clash and she fends them off with her staff, but her clash numbers are weak, so her allies must come and save her. She cannot start a clash (not a close fighter). Husk always breaks her free.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.note: Range 5 (Suleiman, 29 Oct: at least double Gaha's reach, "if not a little extra"). Her AI keeps its distance. 8 Nov (13.29): she chooses her weapon (Switch weapon, free once a turn): the bow reaches 2 to 5 tiles (no room to draw it next to a foe), the dagger only the tile next to her.

sovereign.name: Sovereign
sovereign.note: Gadara the Greater, the Hollow King (Phase 10; 19 Nov kit sheet 'Basic Attack Revision', roadmap 10.23 to 10.29). Guardian, Sovereign subset, Overpower style. The highest health and attack on the roster, the slowest, the lowest evade. 'grip': he starts with the fork end leading (Reverse Grip swaps it, free, once a turn). 'maskGauge': the Mask Gauge, 0 to 5 (src/kings.js, src/data/kings.json; 10.53). Every number is a placeholder. 27 Nov (10.53, Baiyee): a HEAVY TANK: health 54 to 64, defense 4 to 5, magic defense 3 to 4, attack 8 to 7, clash guard 6 to 8; Shadow Step and Shadow Passage added.

vessel.name: Vessel
vessel.note: King Alagara, the Vessel (Phase 10; class sheet v2 'Active and Echo', roadmap 10.17 to 10.22). Scout, Sovereign subset. Weak unbuffed, one of the strongest buffed. His sheet gives no numbers, only high, medium, low: Agility high, Attack medium, Resolve medium, HP medium, Defense low, Focus low; these are ours, placeholders. 'attunement': two Verse slots, Active and Echo (src/kings.js). Cooldowns in place of SP, like Gadara's revision (Baiyee 20 Nov).

slinger.name: Slinger
slinger.note: Leol, the Slinger (roadmap 19.1, 22 Nov; class framework v1.0, chat file 1639). A dual-weapon defensive controller: the sling controls distance (2 to 4 tiles), the hammer recovers it (the next tile). Numbers picked by Claude (the sheet gives none): health 32, attack 6, defense 3, the archer's free weapon switch (once a turn, never a second attack). Passive Prepared Defender (the sheet's recommendation): after a hammer push his next sling shot gets +15 accuracy.

laterSpells.barricade: 1.113 (26 Nov, Baiyee): taken out of his kit until Suleiman sends a proper barricade sheet (4 views drawn standing on a tile, plus a few rising frames); the code and its numbers stay (spells.json barricade, src/newClasses.js castBarricade)

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.note: The Thief, the Infiltrator (roadmap 19.2, 22 Nov; class framework v1.0, chat file 1640). Hide, reposition, exploit, expose, hide again. Numbers picked by Claude: health 26, attack 7, evade 20, speed 12, move 4. Hide: ending a turn without acting makes him Hidden (foes cannot target him) until he attacks, uses Ambush, is hit, or a foe on the highest ground within 5 tiles spots him (Detection). Hidden Movement: +2 move while Hidden, and walking does not reveal him.
